text:
priya: Heads-up — I can repro a bug where the Console shows the Edit button for users with only Viewer at the project level. Also seeing intermittent KMS decrypt errors in audit logs. Need triage. @kai @ash @morgan :eyes:

kai: Can you paste minimal repro steps?

priya: Repro steps:
1) Create org role = editor, project role = viewer
2) Login as user with project-level viewer
3) Open /orgs/123/projects/abc
Expected: no Edit button
Observed: Edit button shows and 403 on save
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://console.internal/api/projects/abc
Response includes "canEdit": true
Logs excerpt:
```
2026-03-19T22:45:12Z | user=uid123 | action=getProject | roles=[org:editor, project:viewer] | decision=allow_edit (source=role-matrix)
2026-03-19T22:45:12Z | audit: crypto decrypt error: decrypt failed: version-mismatch
```

kai: thx. Did this start after today's RBAC role-matrix refactor? (deploy v2.3.1?)

devops-bot: deploy service/console v2.3.1 canary -> prod completed 2026-03-19T22:30:05Z (sha: abcd1234) :rocket:

ash: We rotated KMS alias redwood-console-kms-prod yesterday (2026-03-19T02:00Z). Rotation status shows ACTIVE. I'll check rotate logs; decrypt errors could be transient during rotation window.

morgan: If Edit shows up incorrectly we should consider a UI-side kill switch. Users reporting in support. @lucy what's the volume?

lucy: 3 reports so far, two from customers in EU. All mention they could click Edit but save failed. Escalated to premium CS. :grimacing:

sre-oncall: Recommend creating P1 if we can reproduce and it's customer-impacting. Priya, can you add a diagnostic tag to audit events: role_matrix_version and kms_key_version?

priya: Added a quick log field in branch priya/rbac-debug — will push minimal change to include role_matrix_source and kms_key_alias in audit payloads.

kai: Hypothesis: new role-matrix code treats missing project-level binding as inherited org-level binding but erroneously copies org-level permissions into project-level 'effective' set without checking explicit denies. Frontend gates on canEdit from effective set. Fix: backend must compute effective permissions with explicit deny precedence.

ash: Confirmed decrypt error at 22:45:12 coincides with canary traffic. KMS API returned VersionMismatch for a short window (10s). That could cause audit pipeline to fallback and mark decision as allow? Unclear.

morgan: For immediate mitigation: 1) Flip server-side feature flag to force canEdit=false for viewers, 2) Re-deploy patched role evaluation lib with explicit deny precedence, 3) Add alert for audit decrypt_errors>0.

priya: I'll flip the flag now. Creating a temporary rule: if role=viewer -> canEdit=false in response layer.

devops-bot: feature-flag flip: console.disable_viewer_edit = true (applied to prod - rollout 100%)

priya: Patch PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pull/987 (small hotfix and extra audit fields).

kai: Will also add a frontend defensive check to hide Edit if api returns canEdit but user's projectBinding is viewer. Short-term double-check.

sre-oncall: Running a quick BigQuery to count occurrences:
```
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM console_audit.events WHERE event_time > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND action='getProject' AND json_extract_scalar(meta,'$.decision')='allow_edit';
```
Result: 37 hits in last hour.

audit-bot: incident created INC-2026-172 by priya — Severity: P1 — tag: rbac-ui-kms

morgan: Good. Priya, Ash, Kai — coordinate postmortem. Assign owners for rollback + root cause. I'll join the bridge in 10.

priya: On it. Going to run full repro suite and deploy patched lib to canary. Will post updates.
